    • getPlayerTradeNetQuantity

      int getPlayerTradeNetQuantity()
      Returns net bought/sold, minus what was used to change economy units available on market. For example, if 400 units of supplies are sold by to a colony, this method will return 0. If 399 units are sold, it will return 399. >0 means player sold stuff recently, invalid input: '<'0 means bought.
